title: 用中文或英文阅读
changes: 页眉新增中文 / EN 切换，记住语言选择，切换时保留来源筛选与搜索词。
英文模式显示英文原标题与官网原文摘录；中文模式保留中文标题、译文摘录与英文原标题。
导航、日期、来源介绍、状态面板与网站更新记录均提供中英文版本。
changes_en: Switch between Chinese and English in the header. Your language preference, source filter, and search stay in place.
English mode shows original English titles and excerpts from the source articles. Chinese mode keeps translated titles and excerpts alongside the original titles.
Navigation, dates, source descriptions, status details, and website updates are available in both languages.

title: 字号更大，页面更简洁
changes: 调大正文、标题与导航字号，移除辅助说明。
页脚加入 made by H2O2 字体署名。
changes_en: Increased body, heading, and navigation text sizes and removed secondary explanations.
Added the made by H2O2 signature to the footer.

title: 把注意力还给内容
description: 重新整理首页，让找文章、读摘录和回看历史都更顺手。
changes: 采用单列资讯流，中文标题优先，英文原标题保留在下方；中文摘录完整显示。
新增来源目录与关键词搜索，近期动态和历史归档都可以筛选。
更新状态收进可展开的面板，时间改为易读的月日与时分，保留摘录覆盖率和来源状态。
新增独立的网站更新记录页；手机端使用可横向滑动的来源标签。
changes_en: Switched to a single-column feed with Chinese titles, original English titles underneath, and complete Chinese excerpts.
Added source filters and keyword search for both recent articles and the archive.
Moved update details into an expandable panel with readable timestamps, excerpt coverage, and source health.
Added a website changelog and horizontally scrollable source filters on mobile.
description_en: A clearer way to find articles, read excerpts, and browse the archive.

title: 恢复来源抓取，补齐近期中文摘录
description: 修复来源改版带来的内容缺失，并重新核验近期文章的日期与摘录。
changes: 恢复 Claude Blog、Red Team 与 Engineering 的发现入口，8 个来源均通过真实抓取检查。
分开记录发布日期和修改日期，纠正 13 篇误入近期列表的历史文章。
清理导航与作者栏，修复翻译占位符；本次修复后的近期中文摘录为 59 / 59 篇。
失败文章保留重试状态；来源异常时停止发布，保留上一份有效内容。
title_en: Restored sources and recent Chinese excerpts
changes_en: Restored discovery for Claude Blog, Red Team, and Engineering; live checks passed for all eight sources.
Separated publication dates from modification dates and removed 13 historical articles from the recent feed.
Cleaned navigation and author text from excerpts and fixed translation placeholders. Coverage after this repair was 59 of 59 recent articles.
Kept failed articles retryable. Source failures stop publication and preserve the previous valid content.
description_en: Repaired discovery after source websites changed and verified recent publication dates and excerpts.
